metadata.coverage: Real2025BritishGP qualifying onboard runoff, local black-white curbs and advertising-covered barriers at the main corner complexes. Existing four photographed Hamilton footprints preserved.
metadata.method: Real onboard observations registered to the imported canonical centreline and cross-checked against FIA2025 notes/operator2023 partial gravel replacement.
metadata.horizontalGeometry: Legacy Hamilton footprints nominal15m uncertainty; new frame-derived intervals approximately40-60m uncertain with visually estimated lateral widths. Not a surveyed landscape.
metadata.verticalGeometry: Trees/protection grounded on actual displayed terrain. Barrier/fence heights and hidden construction types estimated; no new road or surveyed terrain heights.
metadata.dateLimitation: Official2025BritishGP pole lap with separately dated2025 FIA and2023 operator maintenance evidence; this is not a2026 sponsorship/facility inventory. Operator aerial photo capture date unstated.
metadata.omitted: Unobserved gravel extents, overhead sponsor gantries, precise logos, altered road/vehicle physics and removed separate runoff kerbs are not inferred.
metadata.advertisingRendering: Generic5x7 geometric wordmarks on sourced barrier faces; no downloaded logos/images/fonts, dimensions/repetition approximate.
limitations: Canonical5891m starts on the National straight before Copse; the F1 Hamilton start is separately located around3.1-3.3km. Shared5819.506m and per-car racing-line distances are not interchangeable.
2023 operator maintenance replaced only part of the Hamilton/Abbey gravel with asphalt. The limited legacy apron remains; no restoration of the whole historic trap.
2025 FIA removed a left runoff kerb at T1, not every black-white approach edge. Changes to red apex kerbs are not added as physical bumps.
2025 FIA describes replacement of T18exitgravel with lighter material; displaytan is from the onboard appearance and does not infer material mass/specification from that wording.
Luffield exit left and later Club/Hamilton exit left are gravel. Copse exit left/Stowe exit left and earlyClub left retain asphalt, rather than making all runoff gravel.
The four original grass/gravel footprints are preserved as draped material masks. New observed masks may refine overlaps. No floating new ground sheets or new terrain heights.
Two existing pitwall traces and dimensions are migrated once for attached lettering; thirteen other pit/service features and their camera focus remain unchanged.
Advertising-covered protection uses a solid visual envelope, without asserting the concealed metal/concrete/absorber core. Event sponsor arrangements can change.
The onboard shows broad open fields. The previous400random illustrative trees are disabled, without claiming a surveyed tree inventory. No original video/photo/PDF is redistributed.

sources.sourceType: Actual onboard qualifying lap; not a video game
sources.independentVisualReview: All three contact sheets and full-resolution 006/039/087 frames inspected
observations: 006s: Abbey approach has black/white edge marking, grass strip and Qatar Airways wall panels; FIA runoff-kerb removal must not be interpreted as removal of every track-edge kerb here
039s: Luffield exit left shows green painted strip then tan aggregate trap and PWC wall panels; right-side blue American Express panels visible
087s: Club exit left shows green painted strip then tan aggregate trap and Qatar Airways wall panels; right pitwall also carries Qatar Airways
limits: Corner positions are inferred from lap order and existing track map, not measured GPS
Widths, trap outlines, wall heights and sponsor repeat lengths cannot be measured from these perspective frames

2025 event advertising does not establish permanent or 2026 sponsorship
sources.rights: Original video/images inspected locally only; not redistributed as game assets or sponsor textures.
